name: Tracking Alpha
summary: Pre-launch tool for discovering and following US cash merger-arbitrage deals, with sourced updates, deadlines and scenario calculations. Waitlist open.

name: Ploutos ETF Overlap
summary: Free tool that compares two to five US-listed ETFs and shows the weight they share stock by stock, every stock held by all of them and what each holds alone, from each fund's SEC N-PORT filing. No account.
